description:
Add adopter-facing reference documentation for the two CLI command families that lack a documentation home: `serve` and `events`.

## Background

Every top-level CLI command family needs an adopter-facing documentation home, and the CLI command catalog (`docs/reference/cli-commands.md`) is the reference home for command families. A documentation-surface investigation found two families without one: `serve` is absent from the docs entirely, and `events` has concept-level coverage of the event log but no CLI reference entry — coverage of the log's format is not a home for the command family itself.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `docs/reference/cli-commands.md` carries a `serve` reference section documenting the family and its flags (`--port`, `--stop`, `--status`, `--fg`, `--log`, `--web-dir`, `--json`), each matching the current generated CLI schema or the current clap definitions.
- [hard] REQ-02: `docs/reference/cli-commands.md` carries an `events` reference entry documenting its `query` and `tail` subcommands and their flags, each matching the current generated CLI schema or the current clap definitions.

## Notes

- Both additions follow the catalog's existing per-family entry conventions (structure, heading style, example shape), so the new sections read as native parts of the reference.
- The generated CLI schema under-reports the real flag surface (clap `visible_alias` flag forms and the global flags are absent from it); the clap definitions in `crates/jit/src/cli.rs` are the fallback oracle for any flag the schema omits.
- Blast radius: single file, additive sections.
title: Command-family reference gap-fill
